notes.title: Demo v2 Big Update Announcement!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604773/4b4905f0b7ba5acefc46e5c794135c70f37f22f1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This demo is intended to showcase polished combat and core base mechanics.[/p][p][/p][p]If everything goes according to plan, we will be releasing more updates soon.[/p][p][/p][p]The following is present in demo v2:  [/p][p][/p][h2]Mechanics:[/h2][list][*][p]Move tower[/p][/*][*][p]Storage & Inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Tower storage[/p][/*][*][p]Tower eqquipment[/p][/*][*][p]Fuse shards[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Craft towers[/p][/*][*][p]Store (Only sell)[/p][/*][*][p]Minimap[/p][/*][*][p]Monster bar[/p][/*][*][p]Monster routes indicator[/p][/*][*][p]Drop system[/p][/*][*][p]Rift system[/p][/*][*][p]Character data menu[/p][/*][*][p]Victory achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Save & Load system[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Towers:[/h2][list][*][p] Balanced Metal Tower[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Weapon:[/h2][list][*][p] Sharp Shot[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you find any bugs, please let us know so we can fix them in order.[/p][p][/p][p]The second map was not included this time due to code compatibility issues for which we will have to redo part of it.[/p][p][/p][h3]Stay tuned and wishlist now![/h3]
